notes.title: Rake in some awesome games during the Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Ah, Autumn…

Not too warm nor too cold, with its charming colours, relaxing sights, and nature-defying coffee flavours.

Picture this: you are at your PC, enjoying a nice cup of tea and looking through the window. 
Suddenly, you see a red leaf fall from a nearby tree: reminded about the fleeting nature of life, you decide to have some fun and play a new video game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/979620b7202d037e939b9c98872ad7549ad6e2aa.png

A bit of a stretch? Maybe, but, to celebrate the season, Curve Games is now offering discounts on ALMOST (looking at you, Ancient Britain DLC) its entire catalog.
What are you waiting for? Check them out on our Autumn Sale page, and rake in a bunch of games at unbeleafable prices!

No, I’m not sorry about these puns.


Steam Awards

The Steam Awards are back, and throughout the Autumn Sale you'll be able to vote for your favourite games in the 10 categories selected by Valve.

We know it's going to be a hard decision to make, but we would like to humbly suggest some of our games for a few of the available categories.


 The Ascent – "Outstanding Visual Style" Award
 Lawn Mowing Simulator – "Sit back and Relax" Award
 I Am Fish – "Best Game You Suck At" Award
 For The King –"Labor of Love" Award
 Human: Fall Flat – "Labor of Love" Award
 Autonauts – "Labor of Love" Award
 Embr – "Better With Friends" Award
 Just Die Already – "Better With Friends" Award

Please consider voting for us if you believe that our games embrace the essence of those categories!


Lawn Mowing Simulator: New DLC and major update

Lawn Mowing Simulator just received its biggest update yet with the addition of string trimmers, giving mowing aficionados everywhere an entirely new way to approach the ever growing menace of tall grass in their lawns.
At the same time, the first paid DLC for the game, Ancient Britain, has been released, containing 4 brand-new challenging locations set in iconic British sites.


Human: Fall Flat - Lumber

Talking about "Labors of Love", earlier this month we released a 19th level for our Human: Fall Flat community.
Born from the ingenious mind of David Nielsen, one of our community creators, Lumber will challenge you with a mix of old and new elements.
So limber up, gather some friends, grab an axe and start exploring this amazing new level!


Space Crew: Thanksgiving Edition
Did someone say Thanksgiving?
Enjoy a delectable festive banquet on the Athena station, courtesy of Wing Commander Lyra...just make sure to keep it away from the turkey that will be roaming the deck!
And remember: in space no-one can hear you cluck...

notes.title: New update released!
notes.content:
We’ve just released a new patch for The Flame in the Flood!

Our main goals are to fix bugs, and alleviate some frustration and quality of life issues that people have given us feedback on. 

The main changes are as follows:

Added Director’s Commentary: the previously PS4 exclusive director’s commentary is available for all. To enable it, you can toggle it on in the options screen.
Fixed Save Loss: We identified an issue leading to save loss when attempting to continue. If you died during a process that advanced the clock (sitting at a fire, sleeping, docking) your save would enter an unreadable state, and checkpoints would no longer work in campaign.
Achievement fixes: We fixed a number of issues with achievements failing to register, including Paleo Diet.
Inventory: Added “discard all” option: For stacked items, you can now discard the whole stack at once.
Inventory: Auto-sort items into existing stacks: When you pick up an item, it will auto-sort into any existing available stacks, or the first available inventory slot if no stacks are available. For example, if you’ve got a partial stack on Aesop, a new item will auto-sort to that stack, rather than into your backpack.
Rabbit refactor: Rabbits now behave like other animals, in that you no longer need to skin them as a crafting recipe, and killing a live captured rabbit can be done from an inventory contextual menu.
Fire crafting can be done in proximity to a fire: Fire recipes are now available near fires, not just while sitting at them.
Added “Craft Multiple” button: Crafts the maximum possible of an item, so you don’t need to click over and over.
More starting bag slots on traveler: New games on traveler difficulty have 2 pouches worth of bag slots already available.
Crafting cost changes: Arrows only require 1 feather, sumac tea can be made with 1 sumac.
Tools can be crafted with a full inventory: You no longer need to drop something to make a knife if your bags are full. Additionally, if you craft a tool that you already have, it will replace and refresh the durability of the existing tool.
Inventory Stacking Changes: Stack sizes increased across the board, and many previously unstackable items can now be stacked, including jars, jar items, traps, and torches.
Added UI element for equipped torch: it indicates the life remaining.
Added quest caches at every camp: So now you can reliably find them.
Added “mute dog” option: Sorry Aesop, not everyone likes those barks!
Marina spawning on endless: Marinas now spawn continuously on endless.


If you check it out and have any issues, please let us know. You can email us at support@themolassesflood.com, message us on facebook or twitter, or leave a comment in Steam discussions.

notes.title: Update - Introducing Daisy Belle!
notes.content:
Hello folks,

Not everyone may be aware of this, but back when we were just getting started on this game, we ran a Kickstarter campaign. We succeeded, and along the way we had a backer contribute enough to have their dog added to the game for everyone to use.

With the 1.1 update, we've added Daisy Belle! She's a dalmation/pointer/who-knows-what mix. You can select her via Scout options when you start a new game.

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy your new canine pal!

notes.title: Hot Fix v1.0.002
notes.content:
Hello folks,

We just posted another update. We hope to have totally stamped out the frequent audio related crash many people have experienced. We tracked it down with FMOD, the creators of the audio library we're using, and haven't seen any crashes since integrating their fix.

We're still working on additional fixes, but wanted to get this one out asap.

Changes:
- Audio crash fix
- Fix for getting stuck at the bait shack upon restore
- drag & drop inventory fix.

Thanks so much for playing, and of course keep letting us know any issues you're having.

notes.title: New Content Update: 0.5.002
notes.content:
We just posted our newest content update, bringing a host of new features and bug fixes. If you have any issues, please report them in our discussions.

Among the update, the major new features are:

BEARS: Bears and bear dens have been added. They are pretty tough, so plan ahead before picking a fight.
SNAKES: Keep your eyes and ears peeled, there are now deadly snakes lurking about. If you get bit, you best fix it fast because a snake bite will kill you.
QUESTS & CACHES: You'll now encounter quests and river caches. Complete the tasks you find for additional helpful supplies.
QUICK DEPLOY: Gain fast access to key items via d-pad or numbers 4-7. Equip bows, torches, smoke jars, and tainted meat without needing to go into your inventory.

Full change list follows:

(NEW FEATURE)	Bears
(NEW FEATURE)	Snakes
(NEW FEATURE)	Loot Animation: loot boxes, cars, water pumps & wells
(NEW FEATURE)	Quest Caches & quests
(NEW FEATURE)	Additional explore islands
(NEW FEATURE)	Backer location names integrated
(NEW FEATURE)	Rare wolf variants
(NEW FEATURE)	Story Quilts (text content still place holder)
(NEW FEATURE)	Aesop's items automatically carry into a new game, unless explicitly disabled in options
(NEW FEATURE)	Screen FX on fatal conditions
(NEW FEATURE)	Traps now pop a warning when they are depleted and can no longer be collected
(NEW FEATURE)	Updated affliction page so you can select your preferred cure if you have more than 1
(NEW FEATURE)	Many new variants for explore locations
(NEW FEATURE)	Improved trap placement with mouse & keyboard controls
(NEW FEATURE)	Numerous additional bits of audio flair
(NEW FEATURE)	Kneeling inventory state, for collecting things like water
(NEW FEATURE)	Status orbs in UI now pulse when in dire shape
(NEW FEATURE)	Fill Gas contextual menu item indicates current fill level
(NEW FEATURE)	Added temp UI to indicate clothing warmth (retuning of warmth values still pending)
(NEW FEATURE)	Quick deploy items from D-Pad: bow, smoke jar, tainted meat, and torch
(NEW FEATURE)	Water collector on raft now shows % full
(NEW FEATURE)	Added alert when an item spoils
(NEW FEATURE)	Added "lifetime" information to inventory UI
(NEW FEATURE)	Added ghost silhouette when player is obscured by geometry
(NEW FEATURE)	Added scrim behind journal so details would be more legible
(NEW FEATURE)	Added a number of new tutorial alerts for assorted systems
(TUNING CHANGE)	Added steel knife and hammer as prerequisite for some recipes
(TUNING CHANGE)	Bow & Arrow now require steel knife
(TUNING CHANGE)	Changed spoil times for a number of items
(TUNING CHANGE)	Increased stitching kit availability early game
(TUNING CHANGE)	Increased moldy lump availability
(TUNING CHANGE)	Pouch description indicates max # usable
(TUNING CHANGE)	Reduced nuts & bolts cost of leather kit
(TUNING CHANGE)	Reduced Small Town camp spawn frequency
(TUNING CHANGE)	Increased rapids speed
(TUNING CHANGE)	More aggressive temperature drops earlier on
(TUNING CHANGE)	Increased briar count in wasteland
(TUNING CHANGE)	Halved depletion rate of gas 
(TUNING CHANGE)	Reduced crafting time for braided cord
(BUG FIX)	Jars lost when consuming from Aesop
(BUG FIX)	Loot UI Could remain stuck open after looting a car
(BUG FIX)	Sleep UI could appear on restoring a save game
(BUG FIX)	Restoring a save game returns you to the correct position
(BUG FIX)	Sleep UI on raft could become unresponsive
(BUG FIX)	Mutliple affliction icons will no longer be removed when 1 is cured
(BUG FIX)	Fixed offset on click to move destination target
(BUG FIX)	Fires no longer block projectiles
(BUG FIX)	Raft boosting no longer possible when collapsed
(BUG FIX)	Resturctured main menu for incoming changes
(BUG FIX)	Fixed Bow targeting FX
(BUG FIX)	Many improvements to Quest panel functionality
(BUG FIX)	Fixed some issues that could lead to river blocking
(BUG FIX)	Opening crows now actual Ais that can drop feathers
(BUG FIX)	Fixed a number of focus issues in crafting & quests
(BUG FIX)	Box traps now get trampled if hit by a large AI
(BUG FIX)	Improved black screen behavior at game start
(BUG FIX)	Improved load flow at game start to reduce load times
(BUG FIX)	Player will no longer become stunned by a smoke cloud after they have left it
(BUG FIX)	Crafting Tools that are in your belt no longer show up in your list
(BUG FIX)	Fires no longer burn indefinitely
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue where move-to locations fought with WASD/Controller input
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue with player getting stuck after dismissing a tutorial screen
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue where player could become stuck in inventory mode after placing a trap
(BUG FIX)	Player can no longer use the bow while crawling
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue where move markers would show when clicking while at a fire
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue where player would slide in place at a fire
(BUG FIX)	While crafting multiples, the crafting screen retains focus on the last crafted item
(BUG FIX)	Fixed a number of incorrectly compressed HUD elements
(BUG FIX)	Removed "caused by" field from afflictions, as it was not usable
(BUG FIX)	Many save/load fixes related to loot, item spawning
(BUG FIX)	Removed icons for unvisitable islands
(BUG FIX)	Added scroll for alert text when it's trimmed
(BUG FIX)	Improved AI Behaviors across the board
(BUG FIX)	Bow no longer duplicates if equipped from aesop
(BUG FIX)	Can no longer deploy/equip from aesop
(BUG FIX)	After restore, 1st explore location will no longer have 2 suns
(BUG FIX)	Boars now splash in water
(BUG FIX)	Animals will no longer spawn under ground
(BUG FIX)	Added interrupt system when equipping items or using journal
(BUG FIX)	Afflictions no longer clipped by gas meter
(BUG FIX)	Burrowed rabbits no longer killed by smoke jars
(BUG FIX)	Fixed issue where dock anim would skip after playing for a couple hours
(BUG FIX)	Non-modal alerts no longer squash or stretch icons
(BUG FIX)	New footsteps sounds for in water

Thanks so much for playing! We'll have more news soon on campaign and our plans going forward.

notes.title: Hotfix #2 v0.3.005 - Bug fixes galore
notes.content:
Hi everybody -- Hotfix #2 just went live. No huge new features in this one, just a whole ton of bug fixes, addressing everything from crashes, to late-game slow-downs to mysterious disappearing rain.

Here's the full list:

 Player can now empty jars
 “custom cursor” setting is now saved & restored
 Consuming a jar on Aesop no longer destroys the jar if your inventory is full
 Cancelling at a well or pump no longer deactivates it
 Inventory focus remains in place when something is moved or used
 Crafting defaults focus to the item list, not the filter list
 Inventory size for the backpack now has a ceiling. After it’s hit, pouches can no longer be applied.
 expanded raft capacity, both default & with expanded storage upgrade
 Fixed floating leftover islands bugs
 Can no longer collect items at a distance by pressing E (mouse/keyboard only)
 ESC now cancels trap placement (mouse/keyboard only)
 Altered rain frequency & duration - it never lasts longer than a full 8 hour rest cycle
 Increased probability of flint at camps
 Rain system alteration: shelter no longer resets rain.
 Fixed issue where rain would break after restoring a save game
 Fixed rain particle bugs
 Fixed crash on docking
 Fixed rare crash on savegame restore
 Fixed late-game UI slowdown 
 Fixed issue with mislabeled Sumac Tea in your crafting menu


Huge thanks to everyone who has sent in feedback and bug reports -- the vast majority of these fixes come from reports by you all. So thanks, you all are the best, and please keep the feedback coming!

 - TMF

notes.title: Hot Fix Update v 0.3.002
notes.content:
Hi all,

We just set a hot fix live that should help with the difficulty, particularly for first time players.

There are 3 main things we've done:

Wolf Frequency: Wolves won't spawn initially, which should give you time to gather up some resources before you get swarmed.

Affliction Bleed Rates: The rate at which a number of afflictions cause your stats to bleed out has been reduced.

Biome Ramp Up: The initial biome rafting experience has been eased a bit, so you'll hit fewer rapids in the first couples miles of the river.

Let us know what you think in the forums. Thanks!

notes.title: Launch date for Early Access
notes.content:
Today is an exciting day for us. We’ve pinned down a date, and are ready to tell the world.

We’re coming to Early Access on Steam on September 24th, at 10 AM PST!

For those of you who backed us on Kickstarter and have already been playing, our early access launch will also include an update with a number of new features. Along with the usual bug fixes and bits of polish, we’ll have a new biome, raft upgrading, and endless mode. The new biome is the industrial area. It has fewer supplies and opportunities for shelter, so stocking up before hand will be very important. Raft upgrading includes a number of enhancements to the raft, to help overcome the lack of resources as you travel further. Upgrades include things like a stove, where you can cook food and warm yourself, and a motor, which will allow you to propel down river faster when you hit still water. Endless mode allows players to see how long they can survive.

We’re really excited (and a little nervous) about going wider, but have been reassured by the great feedback we’ve seen from backers, the press, and streamers who have had a chance to play. It’s been a crazy year for us, and is only picking up from here. It’s hard to fathom that we formed this team just over a year ago, and launched our Kickstarter less than a year ago. We’re all from AAA backgrounds, so going from idea to launch in just over a year feels like a breakneck pace for us. We’re indebted to everyone who’s played, shared us on various social media, backed the project, and taken the time to offer feedback. We couldn’t be doing this without you all.

Thanks so much, and we’ll see you on the river!

notes.title: Backer Beta v. 0.2
notes.content:
The September update is now live! 

This is our second major update since the beta launched, and features lots of new stuff.

As a reminder, if you want to join the conversation about these changes, or the game in general, come join our TFITF Backer Beta Google Group!

Here are the update highlights!

Water V3

We’ve again tweaked the way that water works. Now rather than carrying a single canteen, the player can collect water in jars. These jars can also be used to hold tea or as the basis of a smoke bomb.

Furthermore, when collected, the water is “polluted”: it’s swimming with toxins and heavy metals and other contaminants. The only way to now make that water safe for consumption is to filter it. Water filters can be crafted out of rags and charcoal (now collectible from campfires) and are good for three uses.

Clean water can also be collected from a few new sources: ground pumps, wells and rain.

Boars

We have a new AI type in the game: wild boars!

Boars will leave you alone … until you enter their territory. Then they will charge you ruthlessly until you leave. Protip: you do not want to be gored by a charging boar.

Water Hazards

Every once in a while in a swollen raging river, uprooted trees, garbage and other debris will coalesce into a tangled house-sized clump and float downstream. Protip: don’t get hit by the tangled floating house-sized clumps. They will damage your raft.

More art!

Chad and Sinc continue to throw art into the game as fast as they can. This month Chad has spent on further fleshing out the small town biome, while Sinc works on assets for the next one.

The Full List

In addition to the above, you will see lots of other tweaks and upgrades, including more UI improvements. Here’s the full list:

Water updates:
Water is now stored in jars
Water can be collected from wells, the rain, standing water, or the river
Contaminated Water must be filtered with a Water Filter (new item)
Teas now require a Jar and Clean Water to brew, and occupy a Jar
The Canteen has been removed
Fire updates: 
Charcoal can be gathered from a fire
Lit fires can be used as a sleep location
Buildings: 
Buildings can all now be looted or slept in
UI improvements:
Numerous UI improvements for navigation and clarity
Items can now be consumed and used directly from Aesop’s bag
Options: 
added more graphics options to improve performance on lower end hardware
River Obstacles: 
floating hazards now spawn in the river along with static islands.


Known Issues

Lots of changes this month particularly with water, one of the main resources in the game. Due to this change as well as some others, the game has definitely become more forgiving! So you can likely expect this build to be a bit unbalanced toward the easy side. For those of you who are worried about losing the challenge, don’t worry, the balance issues will be shaken out and addressed in in the coming weeks!
